expiry.description: Default expiry period for stamps; units: s, m, h, d, M, y. 0 = forever.

grace.description: Grace period in seconds for clock skew during stamp verification.

bits.description: Default minimum bits of preimage required for stamp validation. 0 disables bit check.

time_width.description: Time field width in minted stamps: 6=YYMMDD, 10=YYMMDDhhmm, 12=YYMMDDhhmmss.

purge_interval.description: Purge interval in seconds; 0=purge on every access, -1=never purge.

purge_unexpired.description: If true, purge unexpired stamps during purge operations.

resources.description: List of resource-specific policies. Each entry can override expiry and bits per resource.

resources.items.resource.description: Resource name (e.g., email address or pattern).

resources.items.expiry.description: Optional custom expiry period for this resource; inherits global if empty.

resources.items.bits.description: Optional custom minimum bits for this resource; inherits global if 0.

case_sensitive_resources.description: If true, do not canonicalize resources to lower case during comparison.

use_wildcards.description: If true, use wildcard (not regex) matching for resources during verification.

quiet.description: If true, suppress informational output (only output required by flags).

x_header.description: If true, output 'X-Hashcash: ' prefix when minting or parsing email headers.

progress.description: If true, print minting progress (iterations, percentage done).

time_fuzz_seconds.description: If positive, add a random amount (0 to this value) of seconds to stamp creation time to hide exact time.

accept_partially_checked.description: If true, accept stamps even if not fully checked (implies -y flag behavior).

utc_time.description: If true, use UTC (GMT) for time inputs/outputs; false = local time.
